## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) — [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/), see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (or the relevant `node --test tests/<file>.test.js`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] User-facing text exists in English and Portuguese (`public/locales-*.js`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real phone numbers, e-mails or customer data (fixtures and screenshots use synthetic data)
- [ ] Docs/README updated when behavior or configuration changed
